mcqs.question: What was the theme of World Patient Safety Day 2025, observed by the WHO on 17 September?
options: Safe care for every newborn and every child
mcqs.explanation: The 2025 theme of World Patient Safety Day was “Safe care for every newborn and every child.” “Ending Plastic Pollution” was the theme of World Environment Day 2025, while the Beijing Declaration detail relates to the Beijing+30 High-Level Meeting.

mcqs.question: Under the Swasth Nari–Sashakt Parivar Abhiyan, during which period were 13,944 health camps held in Andhra Pradesh?
mcqs.explanation: Andhra Pradesh conducted 13,944 health camps under the Swasth Nari–Sashakt Parivar Abhiyan from 17 September to 2 October. The period 17 September–16 October was associated with National Nutrition Month, not these health camps.
